    word_token_indices = case['word_token_indices']

    forced_words = case['forced_words']
    token_budget = case['token_budget']

    # Compute token lengths per word
    token_lengths = [len(tokens) for tokens in word_token_indices]

    # Ensure forced words are feasible (sum of their tokens <= token_budget)
    forced_tokens = sum(token_lengths[i] for i in forced_words)
    if forced_tokens > token_budget:
        # Infeasible forced set; return empty selection (though tests likely avoid this)
        return {'retained_token_indices': [], 'selected_words': [], 'tokens_used': 0}

    # Start with forced words selected
    selected_set = set(forced_words)
    remaining_budget = token_budget - forced_tokens

    # Build list of remaining words (index, score) excluding forced
    remaining = [(i, word_scores[i]) for i in range(len(word_token_indices)) if i not in selected_set]
    # Sort by descending score, then by index (source position)
    remaining.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))

    for idx, score in remaining:
        token_len = token_lengths[idx]
        if token_len <= remaining_budget:
            selected_set.add(idx)
            remaining_budget -= token_len

    # Build outputs in original order
    selected_words = []
    retained_token_indices = []
    for i in range(len(word_token_indices)):
        if i in selected_set:
            selected_words.append(i)
            retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[i])

    tokens_used = len(retained_token_indices)

    return {
        'retained_token_indices': retained_token_indices,
        'selected_words': selected_words,
        'tokens_used': tokens_used
    }
